usedFor: ClosedLoop AI turns customer feedback into product insights, and Asana receives them as work through “Create Task or Subtask”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product Insight Generated” in ClosedLoop AI, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: Every new insight becomes a task with an assignee and dates, so no insight sits unread.

watchOut: “New Product Insight Generated” in ClosedLoop AI is polling, so tasks appear after a scheduled check, not at once.
